package main

import (
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"strings"
)

// A dependency-owned dynamic value asserted to an interface — local or
// imported — answers from the dependency: an assertion, its comma-ok form, a
// type switch, and a recovered dependency error.

type Named interface{ Error() string }

func classify(v any) string {
	switch x := v.(type) {
	case error:
		return "error:" + x.Error()
	case fmt.Stringer:
		return "stringer:" + x.String()
	case int:
		return "int"
	default:
		return fmt.Sprintf("other:%T", x)
	}
}

var errBase = errors.New("base")

func recovered() (text string) {
	defer func() {
		r := recover()
		err := r.(error)
		text = fmt.Sprint(err.Error(), "|", err, "|", errors.Is(err, errBase))
	}()
	panic(fmt.Errorf("wrapped: %w", errBase))
}

func main() {
	var e any = errors.New("x")
	err, ok := e.(error)
	fmt.Println(ok, err, e.(error).Error())
	var w any = fmt.Errorf("w: %w", err)
	_, isStringer := w.(fmt.Stringer)
	n, isNamed := w.(Named)
	fmt.Println(isStringer, isNamed, n)

	var b strings.Builder
	b.WriteString("sb")
	var v any = &b
	s, isS := v.(fmt.Stringer)
	fmt.Println(isS, s.String())

	fmt.Println(classify(errors.New("e")), classify(&b), classify(3), classify("s"))
	fmt.Println(classify(fmt.Errorf("w: %w", errors.New("inner"))))
	fmt.Println(recovered())
	// Positive control: interpreter-owned dynamic values keep their own
	// method-set answer.
	var local any = localErr{}
	_, localOK := local.(error)
	_, localStringer := local.(fmt.Stringer)
	fmt.Println(localOK, localStringer, classify(localErr{}))
	os.Exit(3)
}

type localErr struct{}

func (localErr) Error() string { return "local" }
